Package mayhemlib.recovery

package mayhemlib.recovery
Bump detection, recovery bridge planning, and auto unbeach.
  • Class
    Description
    BeachDetector
    Decides when the robot is beached (sitting tilted on fuel) from IMU pitch and roll, and which way is downhill.
    Bridge
    A short recovery path from the robot's current state onto the trajectory.
    Bridge.Segment
    One piece of a bridge.
    BridgePlanner
    Plans a fast "bridge" from the robot's current state back onto the trajectory.
    BridgePlanner.Result
    Planner result with diagnostics.
    BridgeRefiner
    Optional second stage that improves a coarse bridge (e.g.
    CollisionDetector
    Decides when the robot has been knocked off its path: either a horizontal accelerometer spike, or tracking error that stays above the bridge thresholds for several loops.
    Quintic
    1-D quintic polynomial with position/velocity/acceleration boundary conditions.
    RecoveryConfig
    Tuning for bump detection and recovery.
    SleipnirBridgeRefiner
    Optional background refinement of a recovery bridge using Sleipnir (the optimizer behind Choreo).
    UnbeachConfig
    Tuning for auto unbeach: detecting that the robot has high-centered on fuel from its IMU tilt and driving off it.
